title: Felt wargame: supply line tracing via flood_fill
description: Add supply line logic to wargame.felt. A unit is in supply if a path of max 10 hexes exists from the unit to a friendly HQ or friendly map edge, not passing through enemy ZOC (unless friendly-occupied). Use flood_fill or iterative neighbor expansion. Out-of-supply effects: halved attack, no advance after combat. Return supply status per unit for score/check_end.
close_reason: Supply line functions added to wargame.felt using flood_fill. is_in_supply, supply_reachable, count_out_of_supply. Type-checks clean (only pre-existing Score alias issue).
